regions.merged_text: God bless you again. I wanted to send you the inclosed card last Sunday before going to Yonkers for the High Mass next day -- and Labor-day Parish reunion. Time was urgent, however, and so without getting it off I made hast(e) to catch a train, etc. Thank God; we had quite an ideal day and celebration. I made a little visit before going down to the Hall, as I was leaving Monday night and offered a few prayers -- pater and Aves -- in honor of our holy Guardians and especially of St. Raphael --- A young Jack Kelly ( ... now past middle age) took me clear to Brooklyn Bridge and into the subway ... Thanks to God -- and His blessed messengers the angels. Time refuses me to give more details. Since starting this letter-card -- your letter and package came in. Many thanks again. Now one or two things I've not as yet found, that would be of quite an advantage here -- one or two of those Fr. Solanus stamps and a dater of some kind. The former especially would help considerably. Many thanks again and God's blessing and best wishes to all.
